units.source_text: 山乡生活虽然简陋，也尽力隆重地款待这位娇客。

en.t: Though life in the mountain village was simple, they did their utmost to receive this cherished guest with ceremony.

units.source_text: 而对于薰中纳言，则看作主人方面的人，随意不拘地应付。

en.t: As for Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, they treated him as someone on the host's side and dealt with him casually, without formality.

units.source_text: 只引导他到临时设备的客堂里，不使他接近内室。

en.t: They merely showed him to a temporarily prepared reception room and did not let him come near the inner chambers.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言觉得这待遇太冷淡了。

en.t: Kaoru felt that this treatment was far too cold.

units.source_text: 大女公子知道他怀恨，很可怜他，便和他隔着屏门晤谈。

en.t: The elder young lady knew he felt resentful and, pitying him, spoke with him through the screen door.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言愤愤不平地说：“老是这样疏远我，实在是‘戏不得’了啊！”

en.t: Kaoru said indignantly, "Always keeping me at such a distance is truly no laughing matter."

units.source_text: 大女公子虽然渐渐了解薰中纳言的性情，但她为了妹妹的事，已经历尽忧伤，因此更加确信结婚是一件苦事，决心独身到老，无论如何也不肯以身许人。

en.t: Although the elder young lady was gradually coming to understand Kaoru's nature, she had already suffered deeply over her sister's affair and was all the more convinced that marriage was a painful thing; she resolved to remain unmarried for life and would not give herself to anyone under any circumstances.

units.source_text: 她想：“这人现在虽然可怜，但倘嫁给了他，将来一定为他受苦。

en.t: She thought, "Though this man is pitiable now, if I were to marry him, I would surely suffer because of him in the future.

units.source_text: 与其如此，还不如彼此客来客去，永远保持纯洁的友情。”

en.t: Rather than that, it would be better for us to visit each other as guests and forever preserve a pure friendship."

units.source_text: 她的主意更坚决了。

en.t: Her resolve became even firmer.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言向她探问匂亲王的情况，大女公子虽不明言，但不出薰中纳言所料，向他隐约暗示忧虑之情。

en.t: When Kaoru asked her about Prince Niou, the elder young lady did not speak plainly, but just as Kaoru had expected, she hinted vaguely at her anxiety.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言觉得抱歉，便把匂亲王如何想念二女公子、自己如何留意探察匂亲王心情等事告诉了她。

en.t: Feeling apologetic, Kaoru told her how Prince Niou longed for the younger young lady, and how he himself had been carefully observing Prince Niou's feelings.

units.source_text: 大女公子对他谈话也比往常诚恳。

en.t: The elder young lady also spoke to him more sincerely than usual.

units.source_text: 她说：“且待可虑之期过去，心绪安静之时，当再奉告详情。”

en.t: She said, "When this anxious time has passed and my mind is calm, I will tell you the details."

units.source_text: 其态度并不冷淡可憎，然而屏门关闭得很严。

en.t: Her manner was by no means cold or hateful, yet the screen door was kept tightly closed.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言想道：“我倘强把屏门拉开，她定然非常痛恨。

en.t: Kaoru thought, "If I were to force the screen door open, she would surely hate me bitterly.

units.source_text: 料想她决不会另有所思而轻忽地爱上别人。”

en.t: I imagine she would never turn her thoughts elsewhere and carelessly fall in love with another man."

units.source_text: 这个性情沉着的人虽然满腔热恋，终于努力镇静下去。

en.t: This calm-natured man, though his heart was filled with passionate love, finally made an effort to quiet himself.

units.source_text: 只是怪怨她道：“隔着屏门谈话，很不痛快，我心苦闷之极。

en.t: He only reproached her, saying, "Speaking through a screen door is deeply unsatisfying, and my heart is in the utmost distress.

units.source_text: 但愿能像上次一样晤谈。”

en.t: I wish I could meet and speak with you as I did last time."

units.source_text: 大女公子答道：“我比以前更加‘憔悴深可耻’了。

en.t: The elder young lady replied, "I have grown even more worn and shamefully haggard than before.

units.source_text: 生怕你看见了心生厌恶。

en.t: I am afraid that if you saw me, you would feel disgusted.

units.source_text: 我还是顾虑到这一点，自己也不知道出于何心。”

en.t: I still worry about that, though I myself do not know what feeling makes me do so."

units.source_text: 说时带着笑声。

en.t: As she spoke, there was laughter in her voice.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言觉得异常可亲，说道：“我被你这种心情拖延着，不知此身结局如何呢。”

en.t: Kaoru found this extraordinarily endearing and said, "Held back by this feeling of yours, I wonder what will become of me in the end."

units.source_text: 说罢叹息不已。

en.t: After saying this, he sighed again and again.

units.source_text: 这一晚终于像山鸟一般分株独宿到了天明。

en.t: That night, in the end, they slept alone on separate beds like mountain birds on separate branches, until dawn came.
